{{Top|leg}}
The '''tarpaulin plant''' was native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Altor 14]]. They evolved to counter the planet's rotational cycle; One side of Altor-14 spent forty-seven [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] baking in the twin [[Star/Legends|stars]] of [[Roti]] and [[Ow]], and forty-seven hours in shadow. As such, all [[Water/Legends|water]] on the planet evaporated during the forty-seven hours spent in direct sunlight. Tarpaulin plants adapted to collect the nocturnal condensation. During the day, they resembled large balls of [[Color/Legends|green]] cloth of varying sizes. During the night, the plants unfolded to create a tarpaulin effect to collect the condensing water vapr and funnel it into the plant. Tarpaulin plants were the primary source of water for most of Altor-14's lifeforms.
